name: HitPay
description:
Connect Claude to your HitPay account and work with your business data using natural language.

Ask about your business

* Sales summaries, top products, and growth trends for any date range
* Sales breakdowns by payment method, product category, and channel
* Individual transactions, refunds, and payment link statuses
* Payout schedules, settlement history, and current balances
* Account status, including enabled payment methods, verification status, and connected integrations

Create directly from chat

* Payment links
* Invoices, with the option to email them to customers
* Products
* Recurring billing plans

All other actions are read-only. The connector cannot issue refunds, cancel transactions, move funds, or change account settings.

Sign in using your HitPay dashboard credentials with an owner or admin role, then authorize one business per connection.

HitPay is a payments platform for businesses in Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines. It supports PayNow, DuitNow, QR Ph, cards, and more than 50 other payment methods.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HitPay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HitPay to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hit-pay.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HitPay MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HitPay lists 15 MCP tools, including get_balances, get_channel_distribution, get_charge_details, get_charge_refunds, get_growth_indicator, get_payout_schedule, get_sales_by_category, get_sales_by_payment_method, get_sales_summary, get_top_products, get_transactions_volume, and list_charges.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HitPay?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HitPay in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
HitPay requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HitPay is developed by HitPay. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
